description: Offline validator and chain detector for up to 50 crypto addresses: EVM (EIP-55 checksum, returns the checksummed form), Bitcoin (P2PKH, P2SH, SegWit v0 bech32, Taproot bech32m, testnet), Solana (32-byte base58, wallet vs program-derived/off-curve), Tron, XRP, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Dash and Cosmos-SDK bech32 chains. Catches typos via checksums before an agent sends funds. No network calls. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/crypto-address-validate

addresses.description: Addresses to check, comma list or JSON array, max 50

chain.description: Expected chain; addresses valid only for another chain are reported invalid with the detected chain
